info.title: Seven-Air-Link M3
info.description: Implemented M1/M2 networking plus M3 Human/Bot collaboration. Browser, CLI and Bot use this same API. No Agent runtime, model execution or A2A. TLS is mandatory; Cookie mutations require same-origin and X-SLB-CSRF. Principal credentials never inherit bound Device permissions. JSON schema-3 storage, not SQLite. Independent HTTP Gateway origin and data-WS protocol remain documented in docs/PROTOCOL-M2.md. Detailed collaboration semantics: docs/CLI-M3.md.

get.description: SSE event types ready, message.created, checkpoint, session.expired and resync. Message payload uses Message schema; checkpoint carries {} and advances the message cursor even across invisible records. At-least-once on reconnect; consumer must deduplicate. Revocation/rotation terminates the stream. Cursor beyond current durable sequence requires explicit resync. Up to four inbox streams per identity, 64 inbox+activity streams globally. --incoming-only is a CLI-side filter, not an API authorization option.

default.description: Structured error; no success is implied

post.summary: Upload raw bytes into a Principal-scoped attachment
post.description: Owner/Member. Raw body, NOT multipart. Max 200 MiB/file, four concurrent uploads, 1 GiB aggregate logical active bytes and 4096 metadata records. Stream to temporary storage, compute SHA-256, then commit metadata; no automatic retry. Upload immediately grants recipient/shared access; sending a chat message is a separate operation. Crash-orphan cleanup is not implemented.

x-http-gateway.login: POST /_bridge/login; application/x-www-form-urlencoded body fields serviceId,ticket; no URL credentials
x-http-gateway.proxy: /proxy/{serviceId}/{path}; HTTP services only; no management API
x-http-gateway.credentials: 30-minute service-specific HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite Cookie, or explicitly granted Bearer. Authorization/Cookie/X-SLB-* removed upstream; Set-Cookie removed downstream. Trusted applications only; distinct paths are not browser origins.

x-release-boundaries: JSON schema 3; SQLite and legacy Python import remain deferred.
No AI task execution, delivery/read receipts, model wakeup or Agent protocol.
M2 local Node approval and explicit service ACL are unchanged.
Linux local test evidence is not macOS/Windows native acceptance or production security audit.
